# [STORY] As a user, I want to upload custom profile avatars and review attachments so that I can personalize my identity and reactions on the platform

## User Story
**As a** registered user
**I want** to upload custom profile avatars and media attachments on movie review comments
**So that** I can personalize my identity and share visual commentary across the platform

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a logged-in user on their Profile screen, when they upload a custom avatar image, then the file is sent to the media service and their displayed avatar updates (`Profile.test.jsx`: `successfully uploads valid JPG avatar and shows success notification`, #116)
- [x] Given a logged-in user writing a movie review, when they attach a verification image or video clip, then the media service processes the file and displays the thumbnail preview within their review (`ReviewMediaSection.test.jsx`: `successfully uploads media attachment with entityType=MOVIE_REVIEW upon form submission`, #117)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 8

## Definition of Done
- [x] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
Consumes `backend/media-service` endpoints (`POST /api/v1/media/upload`, `GET /api/v1/media/entity/{id}`) backed by MinIO + MongoDB.
